upstream_pin.version_boundary: GORM v2 API at exact v1.31.2 module release only; GORM v1, plugins, dialect-specific conventions and later tags are excluded

constructs.invariant: TablePrefix and SingularTable alter physical names; a struct alone does not fix them.
embeddedPrefix changes physical columns and provenance must not be discarded.
db.Table(tableName) can override the model table at runtime; no single static physical table is justified.
Two primaryKey tags require an ordered physical-key oracle; no single-id projection is allowed.

runtime_oracle_plan.toolchain: Pin exact Go toolchain, go.sum/module checksums, GORM v1.31.2 and database driver/dialect on a T20-approved isolated runner
steps: Verify v1.31.2 tag/commit, six upstream source hashes and the exact module dependency graph before running any Go command.
Materialize each authored fixture as an independent Go module; run go mod download, go test and record toolchain, go.sum, compiler diagnostics and package checksums.
Use GORM schema parsing with both default and explicitly configured NamingStrategy to record table, physical columns, ordered primary fields, embedded provenance and relationship/FK pairs.

Use a pinned database driver and disposable database to compare AutoMigrate/migrator metadata with source-derived expectations; test dynamic db.Table values, composite-key order and relation mapping as separate cases.
Require T08 Go semantic/source facts under CR-T10-002, T16 independent read and T19 mutation review before any T10 provider or support claim.
Check T01 contract projection, packed-artifact consumer and certification only after the upstream facts and T00 composition gate are available; preserve the blocked catalog state until then.

limits: The Go files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not upstream source copies, compiled models or executed GORM runtime evidence.
No Go toolchain or database driver is installed for this plan; go.sum, schema parse, migration and live database comparisons remain unexecuted.
The catalog remains blocked-upstream-facts and source-facts admission is not certification or generation handoff.
No T08 Go persistence facts, T10 parser/provider, shared-contract projection, registry entry or packed-artifact path is added.
No independent attestation, target certification or release gate is exercised here.
